english.note: Use this when someone does something reluctantly or against their wishes, rather than simply refusing.
Use this when someone is hostile in the narrower sense of being unwilling or uncooperative.

examples.english: I am unwilling to do this, but I have no choice.
examples.traditional: 我唔情願咁做，但係冇辦法。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 cing4 jyun6 gam3 zou6 daan6 hai6 mou5 baan6 faat3

examples.english: They were hostile to the overtime arrangement and refused to cooperate.
examples.traditional: 佢對加班安排好唔情願，點講都唔肯合作。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 gaa1 baan1 on1 paai4 hou2 m4 cing4 jyun6 dim2 gong2 dou1 m4 hang2 hap6 zok3
